name: Offline MOTD
description: Choose what players see in the server list and when they join while a server is off. Owners can set their own message.
author: Stratosphere

settings.label: Message
settings.default:
§eThis server is off.
§7Come back once it has been started.
settings.help: Shown in the server list, and to a player who tries to join, while the server is off. § and a letter or digit is a colour (§a green, §c red), a new line is a second line. {server} is the name of the server.

settings.label: Text where the version is
settings.help: Short text that takes the place of the version in the server list.

settings.label: Let the owner of a server set a message of their own
settings.help: They find it on the Settings page of their server. Their message is used instead of the one above.

settings.label: Use it for servers that are asleep too
settings.help: Off: a server that auto sleep stopped keeps saying that it is asleep and that joining wakes it up.
